capabilities: derive a first-pass step sequence from Canvas edges and spatial order
reorder, group, rename, emphasize, pause, or disable steps in a Director panel
keep narration notes beside each step for recording preparation
generate a self-contained interactive HTML file via a local Codex executable
follow Obsidian's light and dark appearance in the output
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. HTML generation requires a desktop Codex executable (bundled with ChatGPT on macOS); the directing workflow works without it. Output is written to a folder outside the vault by default (~/Documents/Codex/Cognitive Canvas). README includes a Chinese-language section.
intentEvidence: turns an Obsidian Canvas into a directed, step-by-step interactive HTML experience
problem: Obsidian Canvas files are static boards with no built-in way to present or record them as a guided, paced sequence of steps.

relations.evidence: the plugin launches the locally configured Codex executable and gives it access to the selected project's output folder
the default executable points to the Codex binary bundled with the ChatGPT desktop app

summary: Canvas directing tool that turns an Obsidian Canvas into an ordered, step-by-step interactive HTML presentation for teaching and screen recording.
